# pvecli sdn list

List vnets with their zone and their status on every node.

```text
pvecli sdn list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
